questions.learningObjective: Apply interest on deposits concepts to realistic financial decisions
questions.stem: The setup: At an annual return of 6%, about how many years will it take an investment to double in value?

options.misconception: uses one hundred instead of the rule's seventy-two
multiplies by the rate instead of dividing
subtracts the rate from seventy-two instead of dividing

questions.explanation: The rule of seventy-two approximates doubling time as seventy-two divided by the annual rate expressed as a percent. With a 6% return that is about 12 years. Multiplying the numbers or using a different numerator does not give a doubling time.
questions.hint: Divide seventy-two by the percentage rate.
